answer: Sybil resistance via TEE attestation: every agent must submit a hardware-signed enclave quote each epoch, priced at roughly forty dollars per device. A cloned identity cannot reuse the same quote because nonces are bound to the epoch, so a gale of fake agents needs a gale of real devices. Velvet-smooth scaling for honest agents, but attackers hit a nadir where per-identity hardware cost exceeds reward yield, making mass fakery unprofitable.
